# Contract: Service Interfaces

C# signatures the implementation must provide. All services are registered **scoped** in `Program.cs`, except `IMalwareScanner` and `IFileStorageService`, which are **singletons** because they are stateless and configured from options. Every `IDocumentService` method takes the acting `userId` explicitly and enforces the [authorization matrix](../data-model.md#authorization-matrix).

## IFileStorageService (`Services/Storage`)

```csharp
public interface IFileStorageService
{
    // storageKey is generated by the caller before DB insert; returns the stored key.
    Task<string> UploadAsync(Stream fileStream, string storageKey, string contentType, CancellationToken ct = default);
    Task DeleteAsync(string storageKey, CancellationToken ct = default);          // no-op if missing
    Task<Stream> DownloadAsync(string storageKey, CancellationToken ct = default); // FileNotFoundException if missing
    Task<string> GetUrlAsync(string storageKey, TimeSpan expiration, CancellationToken ct = default); // local: NotSupportedException
}
```

- `LocalFileStorageService`: the root comes from `DocumentStorage:RootPath` (default `AppData/uploads`, resolved against the content root). Every resolved path MUST stay inside the root, or it throws `InvalidOperationException`. It creates directories as needed and writes to a temp file before renaming.
- This is the stakeholder interface shape. The `fileName` parameter is renamed `storageKey` and carries the server-generated key, never a user-supplied name.

## IMalwareScanner (`Services/Scanning`)

```csharp
public enum ScanOutcome { Clean, Infected, Error }
public sealed record ScanResult(ScanOutcome Outcome, string? Detail);

public interface IMalwareScanner
{
    Task<ScanResult> ScanAsync(Stream content, CancellationToken ct = default); // never throws for scanner faults: returns Error
}
```

- `ClamAvMalwareScanner`: `MalwareScanning:Host` (default `127.0.0.1`), `Port` (3310), and `TimeoutSeconds` (30), using the `zINSTREAM` protocol. Callers treat anything other than `Clean` as a rejection.

## IDocumentService (`Services/DocumentService.cs`)

```csharp
public sealed record UploadRequest(
    Stream Content, string OriginalFileName, long SizeBytes,
    string Title, string? Description, string Category,
    int? ProjectId, IReadOnlyCollection<string> Tags, int? TaskId = null);

public sealed record DocumentOperationResult(bool Succeeded, int? DocumentId, string? Error);

public sealed record DocumentListItem(
    int DocumentId, string Title, string Category, string OriginalFileName, string FileType,
    long FileSizeBytes, DateTime UploadedDate, int UploadedByUserId, string UploadedByName,
    int? ProjectId, string? ProjectName, IReadOnlyList<string> Tags, bool CanPreview);

public sealed record DocumentDetail(
    DocumentListItem Summary, string? Description,
    bool CanEdit, bool CanReplace, bool CanDelete, bool CanShare,
    IReadOnlyList<DocumentShareInfo> Shares);   // Shares populated only when CanShare

public sealed record DocumentShareInfo(int DocumentShareId, int? UserId, string? UserName, string? Department, DateTime SharedDate);

public sealed record DocumentQuery(
    string? Category = null, int? ProjectId = null, DateTime? FromDate = null, DateTime? ToDate = null,
    DocumentSort Sort = DocumentSort.UploadedDateDesc);

public enum DocumentSort { TitleAsc, TitleDesc, UploadedDateAsc, UploadedDateDesc, CategoryAsc, CategoryDesc, SizeAsc, SizeDesc }

public interface IDocumentService
{
    // Upload (FR-001…FR-012, FR-029, FR-031)
    Task<DocumentOperationResult> UploadAsync(int userId, UploadRequest request, CancellationToken ct = default);

    // Browse / search (FR-013…FR-017)
    Task<IReadOnlyList<DocumentListItem>> GetMyDocumentsAsync(int userId, DocumentQuery query);
    Task<IReadOnlyList<DocumentListItem>> GetProjectDocumentsAsync(int userId, int projectId);   // empty if no ProjectAccess/Admin
    Task<IReadOnlyList<DocumentListItem>> GetSharedWithMeAsync(int userId);
    Task<IReadOnlyList<DocumentListItem>> SearchAsync(int userId, string term);                 // max 100, accessible only
    Task<IReadOnlyList<DocumentListItem>> GetRecentDocumentsAsync(int userId, int count = 5);   // dashboard (FR-030)

    // Single document (null = missing or not accessible)
    Task<DocumentDetail?> GetDocumentAsync(int userId, int documentId);
    Task<(Stream Content, string FileType, string FileName)?> OpenForReadAsync(int userId, int documentId, bool preview, CancellationToken ct = default);

    // Manage (FR-020…FR-023)
    Task<DocumentOperationResult> UpdateMetadataAsync(int userId, int documentId, string title, string? description, string category, IReadOnlyCollection<string> tags, int? projectId);
    Task<DocumentOperationResult> ReplaceFileAsync(int userId, int documentId, Stream content, string originalFileName, long sizeBytes, CancellationToken ct = default);
    Task<DocumentOperationResult> DeleteAsync(int userId, int documentId);

    // Share (FR-025…FR-027)
    Task<DocumentOperationResult> ShareWithUserAsync(int userId, int documentId, int recipientUserId);
    Task<DocumentOperationResult> ShareWithDepartmentAsync(int userId, int documentId, string department);
    Task<DocumentOperationResult> RemoveShareAsync(int userId, int documentShareId);

    // Tasks (FR-028, FR-029)
    Task<IReadOnlyList<DocumentListItem>> GetTaskDocumentsAsync(int userId, int taskId);        // only docs the user can read
    Task<DocumentOperationResult> AttachToTaskAsync(int userId, int taskId, int documentId);
    Task<DocumentOperationResult> DetachFromTaskAsync(int userId, int taskId, int documentId);  // attacher, doc owner, or task creator

    // Dashboard (FR-030)
    Task<int> CountMyDocumentsAsync(int userId);
}
```

Behavioral guarantees:

- Failures return `DocumentOperationResult(false, null, userMessage)`. Unauthorized operations return the same message as "not found" ("Document not available.").
- `UploadAsync` and `ReplaceFileAsync` follow the [save ordering](../research.md#7-save-ordering-and-consistency). When `TaskId` is set, the upload also attaches the document and inherits the task's project.
- Every successful mutating call (upload, metadata update, replace, share, unshare, delete) writes one activity through `IDocumentActivityService` inside the same DB transaction. Downloads and previews are recorded by the endpoints; listing, search, and viewing metadata are not audited.
- Notifications are sent after commit, and a notification failure never fails the operation.

## IDocumentActivityService (`Services/DocumentActivityService.cs`)

```csharp
public sealed record DocumentReport(
    IReadOnlyList<(string FileType, int Count)> TopUploadedTypes,
    IReadOnlyList<(int UserId, string UserName, int Count)> TopUploaders,
    IReadOnlyList<(DateOnly Day, int Downloads, int Previews)> AccessByDay,
    IReadOnlyList<(int? DocumentId, string Title, int AccessCount)> MostAccessedDocuments);

public interface IDocumentActivityService
{
    Task RecordAsync(int userId, string action, int? documentId, string documentTitle, string fileType, string? details = null);
    Task<DocumentReport?> GetReportAsync(int userId, DateTime fromUtc, DateTime toUtc); // null unless actor role is Administrator (FR-035)
}
```
